title: planner report
description: What the planner worked out for the issue. The supervisor reads this to decide whether the plan is good enough to hand to the implementer.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the issue asks for and the approach taken.

title.description: Short imperative name of the step.

files.description: Repository-relative paths this step touches. Empty when unknown.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, checkable statements that decide whether the issue is fixed.

risks.description: Things that could go wrong and how the plan handles them. May be empty.

issue_comment_url.description: URL of the comment the planner left on the issue with this plan.

blocked.description: True when the planner could not produce a usable plan (missing access, unclear requirement).

blocker_reason.description: Why the planner is blocked. Only meaningful when blocked is true.
